nodes.summary: For a real number $\alpha$, this is the sequence taking $n \in \mathbb{N}$ to the fractional part $\{\alpha p_n\} = \alpha p_n - \lfloor \alpha p_n \rfloor$, where $p_0 = 2, p_1 = 3, p_2 = 5, \dots$ are the primes in increasing order.
nodes.title: Fractional parts of multiples of the primes

nodes.summary: For every real number $\alpha$, the sequence $n \mapsto \{\alpha p_n\}$ of fractional parts of $\alpha$ times the primes $p_0 = 2, p_1 = 3, p_2 = 5, \dots$ is not well-distributed.
nodes.title: Erdős Problem 997 holds

nodes.summary: For every real number $\alpha$, the sequence $n \mapsto \{\alpha p_n\}$ of fractional parts of $\alpha$ times the primes $p_0 = 2, p_1 = 3, p_2 = 5, \dots$ is not well-distributed.
nodes.title: Statement of Erdős Problem 997

nodes.summary: A sequence $(x_m)_{m \in \mathbb{N}}$ of real numbers is well-distributed if for every $\varepsilon > 0$ there is a $K$ such that for all $k \ge K$, all $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and all real numbers $a, b$ with $0 \le a \le b \le 1$, the number $N$ of indices $m$ with $n < m \le n + k$ and $x_m \in [a, b)$ satisfies $|N - (b - a)k| < \varepsilon k$.
nodes.title: Well-distributed sequences
